nodes.label: The Handbook route (26 species reachable, 21 elements)
nodes.rationale: Three fetches per element at ~8 KB each, about 500 KB of context, so six to eight elements per session and three sessions in all. The Handbook carries neutral and singly ionised only, which is what puts six species out of reach.

nodes.label: Three retrieval findings — the obvious route is the closed one
nodes.rationale: The ASD query interface is robots-disallowed or cache-pinned; the cheap ASCII variant of every table exists but is linked behind an image so the fetcher never records it (§19.5.1's law turned on the searcher); and the URL index expires within a few fetches, so a batch cannot be planned ahead.

nodes.label: B.adm needs level uncertainties the Handbook never prints
nodes.source_location: What no amount of collecting will supply
nodes.rationale: Every species above can be collected and the object still stays open: sigma needs the ASD levels output with Level Uncertainty ticked, which is exactly the interface that is closed.
